> {{ site.author.job_title }} at {{ site.author.affiliation }}, Berlin. {{ site.description }} Research and writing on multi-label text classification, uncertainty quantification, evaluation benchmarks, and post-training large language models.

## Publications

- [MADE: A Living Benchmark for Multi-Label Text Classification with Uncertainty Quantification of Medical Device Adverse Events](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.2148/) (ACL 2026): Agarwal, Wenzel, Baur, Zimmer, Harvey, Ma. 488k FDA adverse event reports, 1,154 IMDRF codes, temporal splits, scored on predictive performance and uncertainty quantification together.
- [Zero-shot Factual Consistency Evaluation Across Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.04114) (arXiv:2408.04114, 2024): Agarwal.
- [Exploring Argument Retrieval for Controversial Questions Using Retrieve and Re-rank Pipelines](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-2936/paper-206.pdf) (CLEF 2021): Agarwal, Koniaev, Schaefer.
